description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_pdo_dblib' which implements a database driver for the ADOdb abstraction layer, specifically for the PDO dblib (SQL Server via PDO) backend. It includes methods for database schema retrieval, transaction handling, query execution, and other database interactions tailored for SQL Server.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_dblib
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a PDO-based driver for SQL Server (dblib) within the ADOdb database abstraction layer, providing methods for schema retrieval, query execution, transactions, and database-specific SQL generation.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver with specific configurations suitable for PDO SQL Server interactions.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a database transaction, delegating to the parent class implementation.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table, returning an array of field objects with properties such as name, type, primary key status, nullability, etc.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables in the database schema, optionally filtered by a mask.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with an optional limit and offset, modifying the SQL for SQL Server syntax when needed.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Prepares and executes an SQL statement with optional input parameters, handling errors and setting internal error state.

methods.name: GetPDODataType
methods.description: Determines the PDO parameter type based on the PHP variable type (integer or string).

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server-specific information, delegating to the ADOdb ADOConnection class.
